subject: Secure onramp: MAP deliverables & SOC 2 evidence timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jenny Park <jenny.park@safebank.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Secure onramp: MAP deliverables & SOC 2 evidence timeline

Hi Jenny,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security milestone and SOC 2 package delivery. High-level asks in this email so you can confirm owners and dates:

- Security review kickoff: Target: 2026-10-12 — owner: SafeBank InfoSec (please confirm)
- SOC 2 questionnaire (completed): Redwood to deliver by 2026-10-14 (attachment: SafeBank_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf)
- Evidence collection window: 2026-10-15 — 2026-10-29 — owners: joint (SafeBank evidence owners; Redwood owners listed in MAP)
- Evidence format & indexing: provide PDF/CSV index, sample artifacts, and a README with context
- Final review & sign-off: 2026-11-02 — target close date for security milestone

Attachments: map-draft-20261007.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners & dates), SafeBank_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (Redwood answers - draft)

Can you confirm:
1) Who at SafeBank will be the evidence owner(s)?
2) Is the proposed evidence window compatible with your procurement timeline?
3) Any special evidence formats (SAML logs, SIEM exports) we should expect?

Next steps: once owners are confirmed we'll push the MAP into HubSpot and add the HubSpot link to the doc.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198
[Attachment: map-draft-20261007.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: SafeBank_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jenny Park <jenny.park@safebank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark O'Neal <m.oneal@safebank.com>, procurement@safebank.com
Date: 2026-10-07T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure onramp: MAP deliverables & SOC 2 evidence timeline

On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 9:18 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Jenny,
>
> Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security milestone and SOC 2 package delivery. High-level asks in this email so you can confirm owners and dates:

Hi Marcus — thanks for the summary and the MAP draft. A few quick notes from our side: 

- SafeBank evidence owners: Primary: myself (Information Security Program Manager), Secondary: Mark O'Neal (IT Ops lead) — I'll introduce our SI and IT Ops in a follow-up thread.
- Procurement: our procurement team has a 3-week review window; the proposed dates look tight but workable if we stick to the evidence window (we have internal SLAs to gather artifacts).
- Evidence formats: we can provide SAML assertion logs and Splunk exports (CSV) — is Splunk CSV acceptable as-is or do you need normalized schema?

Action items for Redwood: please confirm the evidence indexing format (CSV template) and whether screenshots / architecture diagrams are acceptable as supporting artifacts. Also, do you require timeboxed access to a test tenant or are extracted artifacts sufficient?

I'll await the updated MAP with SafeBank owner names and the HubSpot link.

Best,
Jenny Park
Information Security Program Manager
SafeBank
[jenny.park@safebank.com]

[Quoted attachment: SafeBank initial evidence owner list (placeholder)]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jenny Park <jenny.park@safebank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure onramp: MAP deliverables & SOC 2 evidence timeline

Hi Jenny / team — quick internal note + answers to the questions below.

1) Evidence indexing: we'll use a simple CSV template with columns: artifact_id, description, evidence_type, produced_by, timeframe, link_or_filename. I'll attach the template to the HubSpot MAP. Screenshots, architecture diagrams, and exported logs are all acceptable as supporting artifacts.

2) SAML logs / Splunk: Splunk CSV exports are fine. If extracts are large, provide a representative sample and then a hash or storage link for the full export. For SAML flows we typically ask for: a 7-day sample (time-bounded), the relevant metadata files, and any associated config screenshots.

3) Tenant access: extracted artifacts are preferred for initial review. If we need to validate a live flow we will request temporary, timeboxed access and coordinate with Mark's team.

Proposed internal owners (Redwood):
- Evidence ingestion & index: Priyom Das (Security Eng)
- Technical reviewer: Neha Kapoor (Platform Security)
- Customer success & coordination: Ava Chen
- Deal owner / timeline: Marcus Lin

I will update the MAP (map-draft-20261007.xlsx) with these owners and push to HubSpot by EOD today. Priyom — can you review the CSV template and confirm the columns by EOD?

Thanks,
Ava
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: evidence-index-template.csv (csv)]

From: Jenny Park <jenny.park@safebank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark O'Neal <m.oneal@safebank.com>, procurement@safebank.com
Date: 2026-10-09T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure onramp: MAP deliverables & SOC 2 evidence timeline

Thanks Marcus / Ava — this looks good. Confirming the ownership and dates from SafeBank's side:

- Evidence owner (primary): Jenny Park (InfoSec Program Manager)
- Evidence owner (secondary): Mark O'Neal (IT Ops)
- Security review kickoff: 2026-10-12 — confirmed
- Redwood SOC 2 questionnaire: we'll review your draft by 2026-10-15
- Evidence collection window: 2026-10-15 — 2026-10-29 — confirmed
- Final review & sign-off: 2026-11-02 — tentative (procurement sign-off pending)

We are fine with the CSV index and Splunk CSVs. We'll send a short artifact sample by next Tuesday. If Redwood needs live access we'll flag it separately.

Please push the updated MAP to HubSpot and share the link here. Also, please include a short column for 'evidence sensitivity' in the index (public/internal/confidential) so our reviewers know handling expectations.

Next steps (agreed):
- Ava to push MAP with internal owners to HubSpot (by 2026-10-09 EOD)
- Jenny to circulate SafeBank evidence owner list and provide a sample artifact (by 2026-10-13)
- Priyom / Neha to review the CSV template and confirm processing requirements (by 2026-10-12)

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Jenny Park
Information Security Program Manager | SafeBank
jenny.park@safebank.com
[Attachment referenced: SafeBank_evidence_owner_list.xlsx (xlsx)]
